Privacy

What we keep, and why

This site sets no cookies and runs no trackers. The fonts come from Google Fonts; the photos are served with the site.

For a slot we keep your email until the day after your visit, to send the booking and nothing else. The waiver you sign at the counter stays on paper, in the office.

Questions or a request to delete: privacy@example.com
